scope: Historical Shan–Chen wetting benchmark for calibration-based contact-angle inversion. The independent m17889 audit rejected the original pass claim. The frozen delivery and both reports are retained for comparison.

criteria.historical_threshold: Relative error below 15 percent for the measured contact angle.
criteria.independence: Evaluate against an independent measurement. A round trip through the same calibration table does not test this criterion.

references.value: Huang, Thorne, Schaap and Sukop, Phys. Rev. E 76, 066701 (2007).
